consumer: An engine-computed threshold predicate over the avatar's own carried inventory that EVALUATES the yes/no 'does the avatar hold >=250 charges of water_clean?' (charge-aware, e.g. charges_of(water_clean) >= 250), not a panel that merely SHOWs the items.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person: wielded/worn/inventory), measured by CHARGES because water_clean is count_by_charges, so 250 'units' == 250 charges, not 250 distinct item entries
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::set_has_item shows the engine answers a possession check via charges_of(item)>0 || has_amount(item,1) over the character actor (d.alpha) -> the load-bearing reach is charges_of for a count_by_charges liquid; src/visitable.cpp::amount_of_internal/has_amount (Excerpt 1) is NOT the authority here because it tallies one per matching ITEM capped at qty and would undercount charges; the decisive charge-counting routine charges_of's body is referenced but not fully shown.
divergence: Avatar wields a single water container holding 300 charges of water_clean. A re-derivation using item-count (has_amount(water_clean,250)) tallies just 1 item and reports 'NOT carrying 250' (false negative), while the correct charge-aware predicate charges_of(water_clean)=300 >= 250 reports true; the 300-units-in-one-container state exposes the wrong (item-counting) authority.
